6d6fbf9d fixes error
90985ee2 fixes error introduced in commit d76b709
d76b7092 (web) reverts to using the classloader of the uploaded jar
816496e3 introduces ExperimentRegistry in o.e.s.c.web to keep track of instances of Experiment, Workflow, and Cache; fixes Cache clearing (now only possible if experiment is terminated);
22481e4a adapts CrossflowHandler.elementToFileDescriptor to take into account experiment input and output path as well as path to input and output file (i.e. sub-path relative to experiment); adapts experiment.xml files; input tab displays input.csv before workflow instance is created (as intended)
4d8a1aee possible fix for eclipse tomcat clean on windows (unable to delete csv files)
d72384a0 adds implementation to auto-start uploaded experiments and adds checkbox on upload experiment page

c712099f adds use of CrossflowLogger to queue clearing functionality for display in Log tab web app experiment page; avoids exception when clearing queues of null-workflows, i.e. not (yet) started workflows
494fbf0e adds cache clearing trigger functionality
db3d51cd Provides a GUI for clearing the cache of individual/all queues
0db10057 adds use of CrossflowLogger in o.e.s.c.web.CrossflowHandler
4a8e1614 adapts CrossflowHandler.isBrokerRunning() by returning a boolean instead of also starting a broker in case it is not running
85fbab5e disintegrates elkgraph + sprotty from crossflow
b382a6eb adds current state of work of merging o.e.s.crossflow.elkgraph.web with o.e.s.crossflow.web
f3fa37cd o.e.s.crossflow.web: minor (runtime model is now the elk model string not a file name)
454e5490 o.e.s.crossflow.web: completes dynamic runtime model loading (next: runtime model styling; model to runtime model transformation)
c0678b8c adds runtime model specification ability to runtime workflow and web app
9e1c9e3f Switched from binary to XML messages
f54e9421 Web app can now work with standalone ActiveMQ
a8b427b5 getContent returns non-null tables
9a197a97 Added word count example
efccb119 Minor tweaks to the UI
05c53ea8 First reasonably complete version of the Crossflow web app
77d14680 Added more functionality to the web app
f5439097 Index and experiment page in place
1b6ccce2 The Thrift API can load and run workflows by reflection
4d390259 Scaffolding for a Thrift-based Crossflow webapp

## Bug-Introducing Commits
BIC: 90985ee2ac46dcd6366bbc14172997a39ea20f16

## Reasoning

**(1) Investigation:** I traced the history of `CrossflowHandler.java` around the line touched by the fix (`workflow.getSerializer().setClassloader(classLoader);`) using `git log --follow`. This surfaced a short, tightly related sequence of commits touching the exact same code region:

- `d76b7092` — "(web) reverts to using the classloader of the uploaded jar"
- `90985ee2` — "fixes error introduced in commit d76b709"
- `6d6fbf9d` — "fixes error" (the supplied bug-fix commit)

**(2) The specific change:** Before `d76b7092`, `startExperiment()` created the workflow with a no-arg-style constructor and explicitly wired the classloader afterward:
```java
Workflow workflow = ... .getConstructor(Mode.class).newInstance(mode);
workflow.setInstanceId(experimentId);
workflow.getSerializer().setClassloader(classLoader);
workflow.createBroker(false);
```
`d76b7092` switched to a two-arg constructor that took the `ClassLoader` directly (`getConstructor(Mode.class, ClassLoader.class).newInstance(mode, classLoader)`), and consistently removed the now-redundant `workflow.getSerializer().setClassloader(classLoader);` call.

`90985ee2` then reverted the constructor call back to the single-arg form (`getConstructor(Mode.class).newInstance(mode)`) — but it did **not** restore the `workflow.getSerializer().setClassloader(classLoader);` line that had been removed in `d76b7092`. This left the workflow's serializer without a classloader set, even though the constructor no longer set it either, since it went back to being no-arg-equivalent.

`6d6fbf9d` fixes exactly this gap by re-adding `workflow.getSerializer().setClassloader(classLoader);` right after the constructor call — restoring the pre-`d76b7092` behavior.

**(3) Supporting evidence:**
- I confirmed `Workflow`'s constructor at that point in history (`git show 6d6fbf9d^:...Workflow.java`) has no logic that sets the serializer's classloader itself — it's the caller's responsibility, as done originally in `CrossflowHandler`.
- The diff of `90985ee2` shows only the constructor line was reverted; the `setClassloader` line, which had been removed by `d76b7092`, was never brought back — an incomplete revert.
- The fix commit's message ("fixes error") and diff exactly match restoring the single line dropped by `90985ee2`'s incomplete revert, with no other logic changes needed.

I'm highly confident in this attribution given the very small, self-contained diff and the clear commit-message chain (`d76b709` → "fixes error introduced in commit d76b709" → this later "fixes error"), which shows the maintainer's revert in `90985ee2` was itself incomplete.
